correctness.rationale: The rank cases are exhaustive: affine deficiency permits a fixed reflection twin at every time; at full affine rank, dependence of the squared-norm column is equivalent by completing the square to lying on one sphere of positive radius. Full rank of H recovers the entire log quadratic from one round: its negative quadratic coefficient gives positive age for known D, its linear coefficient gives center, and its intercept gives mass. In the spherical case the vector of spatial log contrasts is proportional to (z−o)/(t−t₀), with a full-rank linear map, so two distinct times identify any off-center source and no such source is confused with an exactly central one. At the center g(u)=u^(−p)e^(−a/u) with a,p>0. Equal known-mass observations at distinct ages u<v require a/p to equal the integral of the weighted harmonic mean of u,v; that integral strictly increases on shifting both ages by any positive gap, so there cannot be a second match. The one-round collision follows from the strictly unimodal g with zero limits. In the unknown-mass case the derivative of log[g(u+h)/g(v+h)] has the sign of −p+a[(u+h)^(−1)+(v+h)^(−1)], strictly decreasing, so a fixed ratio cannot occur at three distinct offsets. Conversely g(u+Δ)/g(u) strictly decreases then increases, tends to infinity at zero and to 1 on the increasing tail, so levels strictly between its minimum and 1 give two distinct ages and positive mass rescalings for every gap Δ>0. The exact planar witness follows by bounding the stated exponentials (RESULT.md lines 113–119). Replay: RESULT.md Proof §§1–6, especially the two scalar derivative signs at lines 97–109; supplied checker inspected as text only. These are global structural minima for fixed exact sensor locations, a known isotropic D and noiseless, positively calibrated data, not per-source thresholds or finite-noise claims.

value.rationale: The result resolves an exact resource tradeoff on minimal full-span arrays: externally knowing mass saves an entire observation round even though the obstruction is confined to one specific possible center. It also distinguishes arrays where time cannot compensate for missing spatial affine span from those where one added sensor can save two rounds. These are noiseless design and identifiability benchmarks, not claims of stability or field performance.
